firstFrameReview: All 32 selected startup observations visually reviewed: 16 readable Light bodies, 14 visible two-node Mermaid graphs and 2 source-only MD Viewer controls. No restored extra documents in selected frames.
memoryScope: Sum of physical footprints for bundle processes, descendants and all system/XPC services attributed to the application by the operating system responsible PID. Not RSS.
scope: One paired observation per cell; application caches cleared for cold, OS file cache retained; fresh process for warm after completed cold traversal. Default window geometries differ. No statistical ranking.
